definitions.gloss: without difficulty; easily; with no trouble
definitions.explanation: Accomplishing something smoothly and without encountering significant obstacles. Implies the task was completed more easily than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{難|なん}なく⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the exam without difficulty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|なん}なく⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}いた→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: He solved the problem with no trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入念|にゅうねん}→入念：20208_nyuunen⟧な⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦プレゼンテーション→プレゼンテーション：29053_purezenteeshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|なん}なく⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to thorough preparation, the presentation went off without a hitch.

notes:
USAGE:
{難|なん}なく is formed from ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficulty) + ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without). It modifies verbs of accomplishment and implies the result was smoother than might have been expected. It is neutral to slightly formal in register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難|なん}なく⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧ (to pass without difficulty)
- {難|なん}なく⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧ (to succeed easily)
- {難|なん}なく⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧ (to resolve without trouble)
- {難|なん}なく⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ (to handle with ease)
- {難|なん}なく⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧ (to break through easily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難|なん}なく: without difficulty (implies overcoming a potential challenge)
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: easily (straightforward, no nuance of challenge)
- ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: with ease, comfortably (emphasizes lack of effort)
